title: Extended PCA services end Sept. 30, 2026
supports: DHS states extended PCA services will end after 2026-09-30 as part of the transition from PCA and the Consumer Support Grant to Community First Services and Supports (CFSS).
DHS states members may continue regular PCA services until they complete the transition to CFSS.
does_not_support: This transition notice is not a fraud finding.
Existing PCA fraud prosecutions should not be relabeled as CFSS fraud merely because CFSS is replacing PCA.

The provider-news page contains an apparent publication-date typo ('8/28/27') beneath an item headed Aug. 28, 2026; this record uses the item's displayed heading date and the page's current 2026 chronology.
source_locator: MHCP provider news lines 125-131 as retrieved 2026-08-29
